metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot)
metabolic_screening.program: Arkansas Department of Health — Newborn Screening Program
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: Arkansas has NO public downloadable opt-out form. Under Act 192 of 1981 (as amended) and Arkansas Code § 20-9-1501 et seq., newborn screening is mandatory; refusal on religious grounds requires a signed refusal form provided by the attending facility, which is held in the infant's medical record and forwarded to the ADH Newborn Screening Program. No state-hosted PDF exists. The healthy.arkansas.gov domain is WAF-protected and returns 403 for automated checks; program page is available via the Arkansas Legislature's document repository.
metabolic_screening.statute: Arkansas Code § 20-9-1501 et seq.; Act 192 of 1981 (PKU); Act 481 of 1981 (CH); Act 573 of 1987 (sickle hemoglobin); Act 113 of 1995 (galactosemia)
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Collect blood spot per protocol; if parent declines on religious grounds, ensure signed refusal form is in the infant's medical record and forwarded to the ADH Newborn Screening Program. Midwife ordering kits via the ADH supply process.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening (EHDI)
hearing_screening.program: Arkansas Department of Health — Infant Hearing Program (EHDI)
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Same religious exemption as metabolic screening; refusal documented in medical record per Ark. Code § 20-9-1501. No separate state form for hearing. The healthy.arkansas.gov domain is WAF-protected and returns 403 for automated checks; program page is available via the Arkansas Legislature's document repository.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Perform or arrange newborn hearing screen; if out-of-hospital birth, coordinate with regional audiology for follow-up. Document refusal in medical record if applicable.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening
cchd_screening.program: Arkansas Department of Health — Newborn Screening Program
cchd_screening.state_form_note: Same religious exemption as metabolic screening; refusal documented in medical record. No separate state CCHD declination form. The healthy.arkansas.gov domain is WAF-protected and returns 403 for automated checks.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse oximetry screening; if out-of-hospital birth, coordinate with receiving facility or regional provider for CCHD screen before discharge.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.program: Arkansas law — not part of the NBS program
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: No standalone state declination form for eye prophylaxis; documented via medical record refusal.
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If declining: document refusal in medical record. If administering: apply ophthalmic prophylaxis within 1–2 hours of birth per standard protocol.

vitamin_k.label: Vitamin K (oral or injection)
vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in medical record; midwife administers injection if chosen.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.program: Arkansas Department of Health — Immunization Program
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; report to the Arkansas Immunization Registry (ARVAX).

gestational_diabetes.label: Gestational Diabetes Screening (prenatal)
gestational_diabetes.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice; midwife refers out for glucose testing when declined.

group_b_strep.label: Group B Strep Screening & Prophylaxis (prenatal/intrapartum)
group_b_strep.midwife_role: Prenatal informed choice per ACOG/CDC; GBS swab in late pregnancy; intrapartum antibiotics arranged via referral or in-office for out-of-hospital births when indicated.

program_contact.name: Arkansas Department of Health — Newborn Screening Program
